title: The integral of a sum is the sum of the integrals
statement: For functions F, G, endpoints a <= b, and uniform-continuity witnesses for F, G and F+G on [a,b]: integral (fun t => F t + G t) a b hab uFG is Equiv to integral F a b hab uF + integral G a b hab uG.

formal.statement: theorem CReal.integral_add : ((x0 : ((x0 : CReal) -> CReal)) -> ((x1 : ((x1 : CReal) -> CReal)) -> ((x2 : CReal) -> ((x3 : CReal) -> ((x4 : CReal.le x2 x3) -> ((x5 : CReal.UniformlyContinuousOn (fun (x5 : CReal) => CReal.add (x0 x5) (x1 x5)) x2 x3) -> ((x6 : CReal.UniformlyContinuousOn x0 x2 x3) -> ((x7 : CReal.UniformlyContinuousOn x1 x2 x3) -> CReal.Equiv (CReal.integral (fun (x8 : CReal) => CReal.add (x0 x8) (x1 x8)) x2 x3 x4 x5) (CReal.add (CReal.integral x0 x2 x3 x4 x6) (CReal.integral x1 x2 x3 x4 x7))))))))))
